sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, Pedram plays football with his cousin in the park.
sentences.fa: پنجشنبه بعدازظهر، پدرام با پسرعمویش در پارک فوتبال بازی می‌کند.

sentences.en: During the game, he falls, and he cannot stand on his left foot.
sentences.fa: وسط بازی زمین می‌خورد و نمی‌تواند روی پای چپش بایستد.

sentences.en: His uncle drives him to the hospital.
sentences.fa: عمویش او را با ماشین به بیمارستان می‌برد.

sentences.en: The doctor looks at his foot and asks him many questions.
sentences.fa: دکتر پایش را معاینه می‌کند و سؤال‌های زیادی از او می‌پرسد.

sentences.en: "Can you move your foot?" she asks.
sentences.fa: می‌پرسد: «می‌توانی پایت را تکان بدهی؟»

sentences.en: Pedram tries, but he cannot move it well.
sentences.fa: پدرام تلاش می‌کند، اما نمی‌تواند آن را خوب تکان بدهد.

sentences.en: "It is not broken," the doctor says, "but you must not play football for three weeks."
sentences.fa: دکتر می‌گوید: «نشکسته است، اما تا سه هفته نباید فوتبال بازی کنی.»

sentences.en: Pedram is sad because there is a big match next Friday.
sentences.fa: پدرام ناراحت است، چون جمعهٔ بعد یک مسابقهٔ بزرگ هست.

sentences.en: "Your health is more important than one match," says the doctor.
sentences.fa: دکتر می‌گوید: «سلامتی تو از یک مسابقه مهم‌تر است.»

sentences.en: A nurse puts ice on his foot.
sentences.fa: پرستاری روی پایش یخ می‌گذارد.

sentences.en: For three weeks, Pedram stays at home and watches movies.
sentences.fa: پدرام سه هفته در خانه می‌ماند و فیلم تماشا می‌کند.

sentences.en: His cousin visits him and tells him about every game.
sentences.fa: پسرعمویش به دیدنش می‌آید و دربارهٔ هر بازی برایش تعریف می‌کند.

sentences.en: When his foot is better, he goes back to his team.
sentences.fa: وقتی پایش بهتر می‌شود، به تیمش برمی‌گردد.

questions.q: Where does Pedram play football?
Who drives Pedram to the hospital?
What does the doctor say about his foot?
options: It is broken, and he must stay in the hospital for a month
It is not broken, but he must not play football for three weeks
It is fine, and he can play tomorrow

questions.q: Why is Pedram sad?
options: The doctor is not nice to him
His cousin does not visit him
There is a big match next Friday

questions.q: What does the nurse do?
options: She puts ice on his foot

sentences.en: Every summer, Taraneh spends two weeks with her grandparents in the mountains.
sentences.fa: ترانه هر تابستان دو هفته را پیش پدربزرگ و مادربزرگش در کوهستان می‌گذراند.

sentences.en: Their house is small and old, but it is very beautiful.
sentences.fa: خانه‌شان کوچک و قدیمی است، اما خیلی زیباست.

sentences.en: Her grandmother has long gray hair, and she tells wonderful stories.
sentences.fa: مادربزرگش موهای بلند خاکستری دارد و قصه‌های شگفت‌انگیزی تعریف می‌کند.

sentences.en: Her grandfather is tall and strong, and he loves to climb.
sentences.fa: پدربزرگش قدبلند و قوی است و کوه‌پیمایی را دوست دارد.

sentences.en: One morning, he says, "Today we will climb the mountain behind the house."
sentences.fa: یک روز صبح می‌گوید: «امروز از کوهِ پشت خانه بالا می‌رویم.»

sentences.en: Taraneh is excited, but she is also a little afraid.
sentences.fa: ترانه هیجان‌زده است، اما کمی هم می‌ترسد.

sentences.en: The way is long, and after two hours her legs are tired.
sentences.fa: راه طولانی است و بعد از دو ساعت پاهایش خسته می‌شوند.

sentences.en: "Should we go back?" her grandfather asks.
sentences.fa: پدربزرگش می‌پرسد: «برگردیم؟»

sentences.en: "No, I can do it!" Taraneh says.
sentences.fa: ترانه می‌گوید: «نه، من می‌توانم!»

sentences.en: An hour later, they are high above the town.
sentences.fa: یک ساعت بعد، خیلی بالاتر از شهر هستند.

sentences.en: The air is cool, and they can see houses, trees and a river below them.
sentences.fa: هوا خنک است و خانه‌ها، درخت‌ها و یک رودخانه را زیر پایشان می‌بینند.

sentences.en: Taraneh takes a photo of her grandfather with her phone.
sentences.fa: ترانه با تلفنش از پدربزرگش عکس می‌گیرد.

sentences.en: She thinks, "This is the best day of my summer."
sentences.fa: با خودش فکر می‌کند: «این بهترین روزِ تابستانم است.»

questions.q: How long does Taraneh stay with her grandparents every summer?
What is Taraneh's grandmother like?
options: She has long gray hair and tells wonderful stories
She does not talk much and sleeps a lot
She climbs the mountain every day

questions.q: What does Grandfather want to do?
options: Climb the mountain behind the house

questions.q: Grandfather asks, "Should we go back?" What does Taraneh say?
What can they see from high on the mountain?

sentences.en: Every year, the town has a summer festival with music, food and art.
sentences.fa: شهر هر سال یک جشنوارهٔ تابستانی با موسیقی، غذا و هنر دارد.

sentences.en: This year, anyone can show a painting at the festival.
sentences.fa: امسال هر کسی می‌تواند در جشنواره نقاشی‌اش را نشان دهد.

sentences.en: Shiva decides to paint a picture of her aunt.
sentences.fa: شیوا تصمیم می‌گیرد تصویری از خاله‌اش بکشد.

sentences.en: Her aunt is a nurse, and she always helps people.
sentences.fa: خاله‌اش پرستار است و همیشه به مردم کمک می‌کند.

sentences.en: Shiva paints every evening for two weeks.
sentences.fa: شیوا دو هفته هر عصر نقاشی می‌کند.

sentences.en: She uses green, pink and purple.
sentences.fa: از رنگ‌های سبز، صورتی و بنفش استفاده می‌کند.

sentences.en: But when the painting is ready, Shiva does not like the eyes.
sentences.fa: اما وقتی نقاشی آماده می‌شود، شیوا از چشم‌ها خوشش نمی‌آید.

sentences.en: "They are too big," she says. "It is terrible!"
sentences.fa: می‌گوید: «خیلی بزرگ‌اند. افتضاح است!»

sentences.en: Her brother looks at it and says, "No, it is really good. I believe in you."
sentences.fa: برادرش به آن نگاه می‌کند و می‌گوید: «نه، واقعاً خوب است. من به تو ایمان دارم.»

sentences.en: On the day of the festival, many people look at her painting.
sentences.fa: روز جشنواره، آدم‌های زیادی نقاشی‌اش را تماشا می‌کنند.

sentences.en: Her aunt comes too, and she cannot believe her eyes.
sentences.fa: خاله‌اش هم می‌آید و چیزی را که می‌بیند باور نمی‌کند.

sentences.en: "This is the best present of my life," she says.
sentences.fa: می‌گوید: «این بهترین هدیهٔ زندگی من است.»

sentences.en: Now the painting is on a wall in the hospital where her aunt works.
sentences.fa: حالا نقاشی روی دیواری در بیمارستانی است که خاله‌اش آنجا کار می‌کند.

questions.q: What does the town's summer festival have?
Who does Shiva paint?
Which part of the painting does Shiva not like?
What does Shiva's brother say about the painting?
Where is the painting now?
options: On a wall in the hospital where her aunt works

sentences.en: Majid is forty, and he works at a desk all day.
sentences.fa: مجید چهل ساله است و تمام روز پشت میز کار می‌کند.

sentences.en: He does not do any exercise, and he eats a lot of fast food.
sentences.fa: هیچ ورزشی نمی‌کند و خیلی غذای آماده می‌خورد.

sentences.en: One day, he walks upstairs to his office, and he feels terrible.
sentences.fa: یک روز، از پله‌ها به دفترش بالا می‌رود و حالش خیلی بد می‌شود.

sentences.en: His doctor says, "For your health, you should change your diet and exercise every day."
sentences.fa: دکترش می‌گوید: «برای سلامتی‌ات باید رژیم غذایی‌ات را عوض کنی و هر روز ورزش کنی.»

sentences.en: Majid decides to make a plan.
sentences.fa: مجید تصمیم می‌گیرد برنامه‌ای بریزد.

sentences.en: He will walk to work, and he will eat more fruit and vegetables.
sentences.fa: پیاده سر کار خواهد رفت و میوه و سبزی بیشتری خواهد خورد.

sentences.en: The first week is hard, and he misses his chocolate cake.
sentences.fa: هفتهٔ اول سخت است و دلش برای کیک شکلاتی‌اش تنگ می‌شود.

sentences.en: His wife and his daughter walk with him in the evening.
sentences.fa: همسر و دخترش عصرها با او پیاده‌روی می‌کنند.

sentences.en: After two months, Majid feels much better.
sentences.fa: بعد از دو ماه، مجید حالش خیلی بهتر است.

sentences.en: He can walk upstairs quickly, and he is not tired.
sentences.fa: می‌تواند تند از پله‌ها بالا برود و خسته نمی‌شود.

sentences.en: "I am healthy and happy," he says, "and I sleep well too."
sentences.fa: می‌گوید: «سالم و خوشحالم و خوب هم می‌خوابم.»

sentences.en: Now the family goes to the mountains for a walk every Friday.
sentences.fa: حالا خانواده هر جمعه برای پیاده‌روی به کوه می‌روند.

questions.q: How old is Majid?
What does the doctor tell Majid?
options: To stay at home for a week
To change his diet and exercise every day

questions.q: What is the first week like?
options: It is hard, and he misses his chocolate cake

questions.q: Who walks with Majid in the evening?
What does the family do every Friday now?
options: They go to the mountains for a walk
